title: Campus Open Day Activity Board
goal: links activity classification and collection buttons to persist the collection activity IDs into JSON.
summary: Visitors can browse the day's events by category and mark the sessions they want to attend. Flagged activities should be restored when switching categories or reopening.
tasks: Add the "Tour" option in the activity category of index.html, and set the value to tour.
Set #125a46 background and white text to the aria-pressed="true" state of .favorite-button in style.css.
Filter events based on #event-category options in script.js. Show all activities when "All" is selected.
Saves a JSON array of favorite event IDs with the key campusEventFavorites. Restore arrays on startup, add or remove favorites by clicking the same activity button, and synchronize aria-pressed.

example.note: Vehicle list can use stable ID to determine which ones have been selected. After saving the ID array, the same record can be retrieved when the list is re-rendered.

hint: uses the same collection array to determine the status of each button when re-rendering. Saving only the newly selected single ID will overwrite other collections, and fixing an empty array during loading will also lose the recovery state.
